issues.description: The problem statement and UML indicate that acceptSupplyDelivery should be a public static method, but the provided solution declares it with package-private visibility (no access modifier). This inconsistency may confuse students about the required visibility and could cause accessibility issues if tests or external code expect a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the acceptSupplyDelivery method explicitly public in SealSaloon (declare it as public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(...)) so its visibility matches the UML/problem specification and students clearly understand it should be part of the public API.
